heroHeadline: Day 699: Sheinbaum Opens School Year From CDMX Secondary, Launches Mental-Health Program as Government Airs Pre-Informe Media Blitz
heroSubtitle: August 31, 2026 marks Day 699 of Claudia Sheinbaum's presidency, the day before her Second Government Report. Sheinbaum broadcast her mañanera from Secundaria No. 10 in Mexico City's Cuauhtémoc borough to mark the return to classes for 28 million students, unveiling the "ABC de las Emociones" weekly mental-health class backed by 16 million guides, confirming universal Rita Cetina scholarship coverage for roughly 10 million students, and citing a 565,396-teacher survey in which 81% favored classroom device-use guidelines. It followed an August 29 start to a 14-spot government media campaign ahead of the Sept 1 report, touting the minimum wage's rise from 2,800 to 9,584 pesos since 2018, 401 new preparatory schools, low unemployment, falling inflation, record FDI, no gasolinazo, and a 51% drop in daily homicides backed by a 130,000-strong National Guard. Those claims build on an August 28 mañanera where UIF chief Omar Reyes Colmenares detailed a $5.8M recovery from the García Luna-linked Weinberg network earmarked for Guerrero schools, retired justice Arturo Zaldívar clarified the constitutional test for barring fugitive candidates, and Sheinbaum pledged an Ayotzinapa report before the Sept 26 anniversary. The peso ticked back to the 17-per-dollar line at the Aug 31 open after two weeks below it, while August approval polling diverged sharply — from 55.5% (SRC) to 73.0% (MetricsMx) — ahead of Tuesday's report.
